message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The cause is the vendored `slugify`, which deletes any character outside `a-z`, `0-9`, whitespace and `-`. `vendor/` is off-limits, so I made the change in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now strips the accent marks from the title before calling `slugify`.

Shop product URLs (`src/shop/product-url.js`) call the same vendored `slugify`, so they still drop accented letters. I left them alone because you only asked about blog posts. The same one-line fix would work there, or the platform team could fix it in `vendor/`.
